max_age_basis: Largest gap between commits of each file on origin/main from 2026-09-10 to 31c5321 (git log --format=%cI), rounded up to a family ceiling: daily 48, twice weekly 144, weekly 192, monthly 768. Rows not measurable there say so in their note.

fields.stamp.kind: json (a JSON pointer into the file), js_meta (a pointer into an exported object), header (a regex over the first 2 KB, legacy) or build_time (deploy only). stamp.file names a sibling file when the stamp lives there. No git kind: every checkout here is depth 1.
fields.stamp pointers: Each pointer names the key the committed file carries today. Producers moved to contractMeta keep their old key beside generated_at, so the pointer holds before and after their next run.
fields.stamp_next: The contract pointers (generated_at and source_season from contractMeta) a row moves to once its producer's next scheduled run on main lands those keys. Recorded 2026-11-07 in step 4: the producer already writes them, the committed file does not carry them yet. The gate reads stamp until the follow-up repoints it and drops stamp_next.
fields.expected_season: "season" or "base_season" from data/season.json, or null when the file has no season.
fields.season_by_design: null, or the reason a file or its path carries a year other than the setting.
fields.coverage: graded_week, report_week, season_present or games_finished; null for none.
fields.coverage_read: Where in the file the gate reads what the content covers (added to the plan's fields in step 4, because a stamp cannot say it).
fields.tier: chain_input, public, beta, internal or unread. unread: no page reads it; red the day anything imports it.
fields.note: Free text: why a value is what it is, and what is known and not fixed (added to the plan's fields in step 4).
fields.lineage_grace_hours: At least one producer cadence plus 8 hours (plan step 4(d)). Cadence by family ceiling: daily 24, twice weekly 120 (the Friday to Wednesday interval), weekly 168, monthly 744. null only with a lineage_grace_reason.
fields.lineage_grace_reason: Required when derived_from is non-empty and lineage_grace_hours is null: why the row has no lineage clock.
